reference.title: Scenario 3 — Bold-label admonition pattern
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Normal paragraph where the author has formatted an admonition by typing a bold-formatted

section.p: Consider a Normal paragraph where the author has formatted an admonition by typing a bold-formatted label followed by the admonition text, rather than applying the built-in Warning paragraph style.

row.entry: [Normal, Bold run: "Warning:"] Always back up your data before performing a firmware update.

entry.codeblock: <note type="warning"> Always back up your data before performing a firmware update. </note>

section.p: Result: The converter detects the bold-run label pattern at the start of a Normal paragraph and maps it to the appropriate <note type="..."> element. The bold label text and separator (:) are stripped from the DITA output — only the admonition body text is preserved inside the <note> element.
